title: Decoding Register Tokens Preserves Global Scene Details
abstract: arXiv:2610.13299v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Pretrained vision transformers learn structured image representations spanning spatial patch tokens and non-spatial tokens. Recent analyses suggest that non-spatial register tokens encode global scene properties such as illumination, blur, and style. Yet patch-based image decoders discard these outputs, leaving the decoder to recover image appearance from patches alone. We investigate whether retaining register features improves decoding when the complete spatial patch representation is already available. We study this question using representation autoencoders (RAEs) with frozen register-equipped encoders. Our decoder processes four register tokens together with all patch tokens through joint self-attention. Appearance probes, paired reconstruction-error analysis, and fixed-decoder register substitutions examine which global image properties are accessible from registers and how their values affect reconstructed pixels. translated_title: 解码寄存器标记以保留全局场景细节
translated_abstract: 预训练的视觉Transformer学习到跨越空间补丁标记与非空间标记的结构化图像表示。近期分析表明，非空间的寄存器标记编码了诸如光照、模糊和风格等全局场景属性。然而，基于补丁的图像解码器会丢弃这些输出，使得解码器只能依靠补丁来恢复图像外观。我们研究了在完整空间补丁表示已经可用的情况下，保留寄存器特征能否改善解码效果。我们使用带有冻结的、配备寄存器编码器的表示自编码器（RAEs）来研究这一问题。我们的解码器通过联合自注意力机制，将四个寄存器标记与所有补丁标记一起处理。外观探针、配对重建误差分析以及固定解码器下的寄存器替换实验，检验了哪些全局图像属性可以从寄存器中读取，以及它们的取值如何影响重建的像素。对于生成（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究发现，让表示自编码器（RAE）的解码器通过联合自注意力同时处理寄存器标记与全部补丁标记，能够保留光照、模糊、风格等全局场景细节，从而提升图像重建质量。
en_tdlr: Jointly decoding register tokens alongside all patch tokens in representation autoencoders preserves global scene details such as illumination, blur, and style, improving image reconstruction quality.
